title: Full-Stack Web Development Mastery
description: Comprehensive journey from HTML/CSS fundamentals to modern React frontends, robust Laravel APIs, and live cloud deployment.
overview: Designed for aspiring software developers, this hands-on course covers modern frontend and backend architectures. You will build real-world responsive web applications, integrate relational databases, handle authentication, and deploy production-grade code with automated workflows.
requirements: Access to a personal computer or laptop (Windows, macOS, or Linux)
Reliable internet connection for live sessions and collaborative coding
Basic understanding of computer operations and file management
Willingness to dedicate 6-8 hours per week to exercises and projects

level_progression.details: HTML5 semantic structure, modern CSS3 layout systems (Flexbox & Grid), JavaScript essentials, DOM manipulation, and Git/GitHub version control.
Component-driven development with React & Tailwind CSS, RESTful API consumption, state management, backend routing, and database schema design.
Full-stack authentication (OAuth/Sanctum), full CRUD API development, asynchronous background queues, testing, and production deployment with CI/CD.

key_outcome: Build, test, and deploy 3 production-grade portfolio web applications, complete with interactive UI, secure APIs, and responsive design.

title: Python & Data Science Foundations
description: Master core Python programming, data analysis with Pandas and NumPy, data visualization, and foundational machine learning techniques.
overview: An applied, project-based introduction to the Python data stack. Learners explore real-world datasets, clean messy data, perform statistical analysis, create interactive visual dashboards, and train predictive machine learning models.
requirements: A laptop with at least 8GB RAM
Basic mathematical literacy (algebra and basic statistics)

level_progression.details: Python syntax, control flow, functions, modular code structure, and working with CSV/JSON files.
Data manipulation with Pandas, numerical computing with NumPy, and exploratory data analysis (EDA).
Data visualization with Matplotlib/Seaborn, statistical hypothesis testing, and introductory Scikit-Learn models.

key_outcome: Extract actionable business insights from raw data, produce reproducible Jupyter analytical reports, and train baseline predictive models.
